Class CompilationProfiler

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.python.compiler.CompilationProfiler
@Internal public final class CompilationProfiler extends Object
Collects the CompilationProfile of one compilation: phases are timed inclusively from phase(String) to the close of the span it returns, counters accumulate, and the output directory is inventoried once the compilation wrote it. Nothing here runs unless profiling was enabled on the compiler; a null profiler is a no-op at every call site through the static span(CompilationProfiler, String) and increment(CompilationProfiler, String, long).

The profiler is used from one thread at a time (the compiler runs javac on the calling thread), but the methods synchronise anyway so a callback from another thread cannot corrupt it.

Since:
5.3.0
